description: 4 should-trigger + 3 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers mocking-the-mock, production pollution (test-only methods on production classes), overfit assertions, and a German phrasing of the same concern. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbors: deciding test order before any code exists (test-driven-development), detecting what slipped through after the fact (judge-test-coverage), and a plain request to add tests with no anti-pattern signal.

queries.q: is it ok to mock the mock I just wrote in this test?
should I add a test-only helper method to this production class?
this assertion only passes for the one example I hardcoded, is that fine?
ist es ein Problem, wenn ich eine test-spezifische Methode in die Produktionsklasse einbaue?
should I write the test before or after the implementation for this feature?
queries.note: sequencing of test vs code is test-driven-development's scope, not a mock/pollution/overfit check

queries.q: run a coverage pass over the PR and flag any test that slipped through weak
queries.note: post-hoc detection is judge-test-coverage; this skill is the prevention layer before writing

queries.q: add a few tests for this new function
queries.note: a plain test-writing request with no anti-pattern signal named
